comment: User-facing sound settings for the S10+ (beyond2lte). bg-03 owns this contract; briq-06d renders Settings -> Sound and the launcher's volume HUD. Everything here is read from the REAL card ('beyond-madera') by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-audio-diag.sh; no control name is invented. Hard rule: a writable mixer control is NOT audibility - every audible claim stays NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.

read_api.note: every row on the page must name the command that produced it

safety.step_per_press: 5% of the element range (range / 20, floored at 1) - the same formula the A32 button manager and the FSM use
never: disable the CS35L41 amplifier protection or the thermal limits
run a tone longer than the bounded duration or above the cap
claim audibility from a mixer write

rows.title: Media volume up / down
rows.read_api: the album control of card 'beyond-madera' (discovered, never hard-coded)
rows.dispatch: button manager (volume keys / hands-free) and the volume HUD
rows.honesty: the number shown is the mixer value; whether it is audible is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST

rows.title: Mute / unmute
rows.read_api: the playback switch of the same element (amixer sget)
rows.honesty: a control without a playback switch is reported as unsupported, not silently ignored

rows.title: Sound mode: normal / vibrate / silent
written_by: the Power+VolumeUp chord in the button manager (briq-03e)
rows.contract: both writers use the same file, so the button chord and the Settings row can never disagree
rows.honesty: the mode is recorded and the playback switch follows it; VIBRATE also needs the vibrator path (briq-08b) and is reported as requested-not-proven

rows.title: Output selection
rows.read_api: nuxelctl audio settings (sink list when a session manager answers) + nuxelctl headphone route
rows.honesty: with no PipeWire/WirePlumber session the list is reported as unavailable; the ALSA element is still shown so the state is not hidden

rows.title: Per-app volume
rows.read_api: wpctl set-volume <node-id> (wireplumber) / pactl for PulseAudio-compatible clients
rows.honesty: only offered when the session manager really exposes a per-node volume; otherwise the row says unsupported instead of faking a slider

rows.title: Microphone input selection
rows.read_api: the capture control of card 'beyond-madera' + the source list (jack headset mic vs built-in)
rows.honesty: a chosen source is not proof of a recording; mic capture is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST

rows.title: Notification and touch sounds
fields: notification volume (where a separate stream exists)
rows.honesty: these are display/UX preferences plus a stream volume; no audible claim is made

never_claims: that sound is audible because a control accepted a value: a writable control is not audibility
that the CS35L41 amplifiers are driven correctly because the DAC reports RUNNING
that the headphone jack silences the speaker because a route rule exists (that is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST)
that Bluetooth A2DP playback implies A2DP microphone support
conflict_rule: bg-03 owns configs/alsa-ucm/**, configs/pipewire/**, configs/wireplumber/** and tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-audio-diag.sh; briq-06d owns the Settings pages; briq-08d owns Bluetooth.
